hypothesis.thinking: R1: 结构假设 blur->JPEG。blur 证据: gm_ratio=0.510(sev~3), spectral_slope_ratio=1.168, kernel PCA=1.035 各向同性(非motion), glass_score=1.495 远超玻璃校准区间0.19-0.41 疑为JPEG块效应FP -> 优先测 gaussian。JPEG 证据: block_boundary=7.345(0%FP), dct_zero_ratio=0.9105 -> 强压缩 sev4 起点。
R2 control: 单独 JPEG:4, 验证 blur 是否真实存在。若单 JPEG PSNR 与 blur+jpeg 接近, 说明 gm_ratio=0.51 全部来自 JPEG 高频衰减; 若明显更低, 说明 blur 独立存在。
R3: JPEG severity 扫描 4->3 (quality 12 vs 8)。target extreme_pct=0.39% 低于 jpeg:4 模拟的 ~1.96%, 提示压缩可能更轻; block_boundary(analyze版)12%误差在阈值内。
R4: JPEG severity 扫描 4->5 (quality 5)。jpeg:4 CI 7/10 优于 jpeg:3 5/10, 检查更强压缩是否进一步匹配。
R5: blur severity 扫描 (指定 jpeg:4 已是最佳 JPEG 单步)。gaussian sev1(sigma=1) 测试轻度模糊假设, gm_ratio=0.51 可能主要来自 JPEG 高频衰减。
R6: blur severity 扫描。g1+j4 PSNR 25.37 < g3+j4 26.29, 说明目标比 sev1 更模糊; 测 sev2 找最优点。
R7: 视觉 1:1 对比显示 target 比 g3+j4 更模糊(鸟头羽毛细节更软) -> blur severity 上探 sev4。

R8: 3步假设。证据: target saturation_mean 135.7 vs clean 159.8(-15%), impulse_total_pct 0.386% vs clean 2.0%(-80%), variance_ratio=0.79, mean_shift 仅5/255 -> 全局对比度/色度压缩而非亮度。brightness 各档 shift>=25 可排除。contrast_weaken_stretch 最温和档(sev1,c=1.0)优先, JPEG:4 与 blur:3 沿用已建立的最佳单步。

R9: 全局步骤假设。单函数 profile: saturate_weaken_YCrCb:1 在 clean 上 shift=+4.86 (target +5.05), var_ratio=0.850 (target 0.790, 叠加JPEG/模糊~0.97 后~0.82), S=0.665 (target 0.849/跨对均值0.773), pct<=1 降至 0.017% (JPEG 再引入暗块); 5 对支持图像一致显示色度-23%/方差-28%/削顶消除。contrast_weaken_scale:1 var=0.563 过强, stretch shift=+35 排除。
R10: 对比度削弱假设(scale=0.75)。残差-强度拟合斜率约-0.11 -> 目标疑似仿射压缩(f~0.89); 虽0.75略强, 但模糊/JPEG 干扰斜率估计, 需 PSNR 仲裁。S_ratio 0.729 接近跨对均值0.77。

R11: 无 blur 假设! 定量: lap_var target/clean=37.5/85.0=0.441; contrast0.75(jpeg后系数0.785)预测 0.75^2*0.785=0.442 完美; grad target/clean=14.89/21.68=0.687; 预测 0.75*0.924=0.693 完美。gm_ratio=0.51 可由 contrast+JPEG 解释, 不需要 blur。方差比 0.79 vs 预测0.56 仍有差距待验证。

R12: 顺序假设反转 JPEG->blur。证据: (1) 残差-强度曲线暗部+12.6/亮部-10 = JPEG振铃(亮侧过冲/暗侧下冲)被后续模糊平滑的典型特征; (2) target pct<=1 0.386% 远低于 jpeg-only 2.24%, 但模糊前置时仍1.8-2.0%; (3) block_boundary target(analyze版)0.61 低于 jpeg-only 0.68; (4) 全局方差0.79。梯度能量 gradvar=21.8 与 g3+jpeg 相同 -> blur 量级 sev3 不变。
R13: lens 子类型对照。lens:4(disk r=6) 的 gm=0.353 与 gaussian:3(0.356) 等价; SKILL 指出 gaussian<->lens MTF 不可区分, 必须 PSNR 仲裁。

R14: 工具推荐 glass:3 验证。glass_score=1.495>0.25 但已证伪: g4+j4 模拟图 glass_score=1.505 与 target 相同, 该指标在此图上受模糊量主导而非 shuffle 结构。glass 的随机 shuffle 保直方图, 理论上无法解释 target 的色调压缩/方差0.79; 且跨 seed 不可复现。用 PSNR 仲裁: 若 >=26 则 glass 仍可能, <24 则排除。
R15: JPEG severity 上探。block_boundary(compare版) target 0.6095 与 jpeg:5 完全一致(0% diff), jpeg:4 偏高12%; dct_zero target 0.9105, g3+j4 0.9209 略高。测 g3+j5 验证是否更优。
R16 SUPPORT_1 交叉验证: 支持对应与 target 共享同一退化管线。若 PSNR 与 CI 模式与 target 一致(~26dB/7-10), 说明类型判断稳定, 残差为系统性参数偏差。

R1-1 missed-noise probe (signal mode): R0 quoted peeled sigma only from pair0 (raw 0.74 / peeled 1.48), but re-running peeled_noise_check on all 5 support pairs gives peeled sigma 1.48/4.94/2.97/0.74/2.22; SKILL states wavelet sigma is a LOWER BOUND when blur is present, and blur_gaussian:3 (sigma=3) attenuates a pre-blur gaussian sev1 (sigma 12.75) to ~1.2 gray levels by kernel L2 norm sqrt(1/(4*pi*9)). Physics permits noise<blur (sensor noise before optics), so a hidden noise step is not excludable from sigma alone. Validate by statistics only (noise -> verify_signals), not PSNR.

R1-2 global chroma reopening: second-order statistics across all 5 support pairs show saturation_chroma_ratio target/clean = 0.8865/0.8135/0.69/0.77/0.75 (mean ~0.774), and run_full_analysis on pair1 emits SATURATION_weaken_sev3. R0 tested only saturate_weaken_YCrCb:1 (S*0.6), which overshoots the measured ratio (0.665 vs 0.773); the closest legal function is saturate_weaken_HSV:1 (S*0.7). Keep the Tier-S JPEG (block_boundary) and established gaussian:3 blur; test whether an explicit saturation step reduces the systematic residual. Deterministic pipeline -> PSNR mode valid (sigma<2).

R1-3 order/global variant: deterministic peel (blur_gaussian:3 + compression_jpeg:4) leaves residual_std 10.2-11.9 gray levels on ALL five support pairs, and target_gray = P + 0.84*(clean_gray - P) with variance_ratio ~= f^2 — a real affine tone compression that neither blur nor JPEG can produce. R0 tested contrast_weaken_scale:1 only BEFORE JPEG (25.47 dB, overshoot f); per SKILL physical constraints contrast and JPEG are both priority-2 ISP steps and the generator may shuffle them, so JPEG->contrast is legal and untested. Applying contrast after JPEG also attenuates JPEG artifacts. f=0.75 still overshoots measured ~0.84 but is the closest legal tone function. Deterministic -> PSNR mode.

R1-4 cross-pair stability of the R0 primary pipeline on SUPPORT_2 (worst case: smallest tone factor f=0.771, highest peeled sigma 2.97 of the 5 pairs). Deterministic peel residual std is constant 10.2-11.9 across pairs, which points to one systematic missing component; if g3+j4 reproduces ~26 dB with the same dark-clipping CI failure pattern here, the systematic-residual interpretation is confirmed on a second independent pair (R0 checked only pair 1). Deterministic -> PSNR mode.

final_decision.rationale: JPEG presence is 0%-FP (block_boundary=7.3446) and blur presence is well supported (gm_ratio=0.510, spectral slope 1.168, isotropic kernel PCA=1.035, anisotropy 1.44). Gaussian and lens are MTF-indistinguishable (26.29 vs 26.28 dB), glass is a glass_score false positive, motion is excluded. Noise is absent. Order blur->JPEG confirmed by CI (reverse order breaks block_boundary/overshoot). Residual analysis on all 5 support pairs reveals a real affine global compression (f~0.84, fixed pivot ~118-128, variance ratio=f^2, saturation ratio~f, clipping lifted) that no legal single global function reproduces exactly (contrast_weaken_scale:1 = 0.75 with mean pivot); the closest legal representations are kept as alternatives for training-PSNR arbitration. PSNR 26.29 < 30 -> severity and the global component unverified -> UNCERTAIN, not LIKELY.

Severity g3 vs g4 tie (+0.02 dB) -> keep g3.
consolidated_findings.compression_severity: jpeg:4 retained. Presence is Tier S (block_boundary 4.19-7.34, 0% FP, all pairs). sigma<2 so PSNR is the valid severity arbiter: j4 26.29 dB CI 7/10 vs j5 24.76 CI 5/10 vs j3 24.80 CI 5/10. Strict verify_signals block_boundary gap 19.5% (sim 5.915 vs target 7.3446) is explained by an unmodeled tone compression amplifying block steps (1/0.84 ~ 1.19), not by stronger JPEG; dct_zero_ratio diff 0.0092 matches.
consolidated_findings.second_order_statistics: Deterministic blur+jpeg peel leaves residual_std 11.2/11.5/10.2/11.9/11.2 gray levels on pairs 0-4 (constant -> one systematic missing component). variance_ratio 0.7898/0.7145/0.6463/0.7245/0.7036 with small sign-inconsistent mean_shift (-0.3 to +5.0/255); consistent with an affine tone compression f~0.80-0.89 around the image mean (R0 fit: target = P + 0.84*(clean-P), pivot 118-128). No legal bank function reproduces f~0.84: contrast_weaken_scale:1=0.75 (overshoot) tested before (-0.82 dB) and after (-0.33 dB, CI 4/10) JPEG; saturate_weaken_HSV:1 (S*0.7) tested -2.03 dB; saturate_weaken_YCrCb:1 (S*0.6) 23.65 dB (R0, -2.64 dB). Chroma reduction is already produced by JPEG q=8 4:2:0. Tool per-pair global verdicts flip (NO_GLOBAL/SATURATION/CONTRAST, all low confidence with FP_global_risk) -> global DT unreliable under mixed degradation; the cross-pair affine is the reliable statistic.
